name: Protocol Focus
description: Developer immersion mode: launches VS Code, terminal, silences distractions, and starts deep work timer.
voiceConfirmation: Protocol Focus initiated, sir. Developer environment deployed, distractions cleared, and audio attenuated.

name: Protocol Chill
description: Recreation & entertainment mode: opens Spotify, YouTube, and dials up audio.
voiceConfirmation: Protocol Chill engaged, sir. Media systems online and volume dialed up.

name: Protocol Clean Slate
description: Closes entertainment apps and browser tabs, cleans up workspace.
voiceConfirmation: Protocol Clean Slate in progress. Clearing workspace distractions.

name: Protocol Nightfall
description: End-of-day sequence: mutes master audio, closes running media, and secures workstation.
voiceConfirmation: Initiating Protocol Nightfall, sir. Silencing audio and securing workstation.
